description: Pins protocol::phrase::normalize_user_phrase byte mapping for cross-implementation conformance. Input and expected output strings are UTF-8 byte sequences hex-encoded; consumers decode as UTF-8 strings before piping through their language's normalize_user_phrase port. The pipeline is: (1) NFKD compatibility decomposition; (2) ASCII lowercase; (3) trim leading and trailing whitespace; (4) collapse runs of whitespace between tokens to a single ASCII space U+0020. Wordlist validation is intentionally NOT applied here per recovery-flow.md §3.2 — invalid phrases produce a normalized string that fails AEAD-tag verification at the recovery_wrap unwrap stage.

cases.description: Already-canonical 24-word ASCII single-space-joined BIP-39 phrase passes through unchanged.
Full-width digits U+FF10..U+FF19 NFKD-decompose to ASCII 0..9. Input substring '\uFF10\uFF11\uFF12' becomes '012'.
NO-BREAK SPACE U+00A0 NFKD-decomposes to ASCII U+0020 and is then folded by the trim + whitespace-coalesce step.
Ligature U+FB01 (ﬁ) NFKD-decomposes to two ASCII chars f + i; output byte length differs from input. Implementations that allocate output strictly against input byte length must handle the expansion.
ASCII uppercase input lowercased to match the BIP-39 English wordlist's lowercase canonical form.
Runs of one or more whitespace characters between tokens collapse to a single ASCII space U+0020. Input contains four ASCII spaces and two tab characters between distinct tokens.
Leading and trailing whitespace runs are trimmed without leaving an emitted space at either end.

Realistic password-manager paste exercising every step in one input: leading + trailing ASCII space, full-width Latin letter U+FF21 (Ａ) appended to ASCII ABC, two consecutive NO-BREAK SPACE U+00A0 between words, mixed case, full-width Latin letter U+FF22 (Ｂ) appended after def. Final output is 'abca defb'.
Pure whitespace input (ASCII spaces, tab, newline, NO-BREAK SPACE) has no tokens to emit; output is empty.
